user.title: Librus Synergia login
user.description: Enter the login and password of a parent or student account. One entry is one student.

data_description.username: Librus Synergia login of the parent or student account.

developer.name: Developer options
developer.description: Only for tests with a mock server. Leave empty for the real Librus Synergia.

data_description.server_url: Address of a Librus Synergia mock, for example http://librus-mock-a:8000. With a server URL the login is skipped.

settings.title: Update settings
settings.description: How often Librus is read, how many months of the schedule and weeks of the timetable are read and how many messages are kept. You can change this later.

data_description.interval_student: Minutes between updates of the student info and bell times (10–1440).
data_description.interval_lucky_number: Minutes between updates of the lucky number (10–1440).
data_description.interval_grades: Minutes between updates of the grades (10–1440).
data_description.interval_messages: Minutes between updates of the message list (10–1440).
data_description.interval_announcements: Minutes between updates of the announcements (10–1440).
data_description.interval_schedule: Minutes between updates of the schedule (10–1440).
data_description.interval_timetable: Minutes between updates of the timetable (10–1440).
data_description.timeframe: The current month plus this many months (0–6).
data_description.timetable_weeks: The current week plus this many weeks (0–4). One request per week.
data_description.message_count: How many of the last messages are read (1–100).

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Librus no longer accepts the password of {name}. Enter the login and the current password of the same account.

data_description.username: Login of the same Librus Synergia account.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Librus Synergia. Try again later.
error.maintenance: Librus Synergia is in maintenance. Try again later.
error.invalid_url: The server URL must start with http:// or https://.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This login is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This login belongs to a different account. Use the login of this entry.

init.title: Settings
init.description: How often Librus is read, how many months of the schedule and weeks of the timetable are read and how many messages are kept. The integration reloads after saving.

data_description.interval_student: Minutes between updates of the student info and bell times (10–1440).
data_description.interval_lucky_number: Minutes between updates of the lucky number (10–1440).
data_description.interval_grades: Minutes between updates of the grades (10–1440).
data_description.interval_messages: Minutes between updates of the message list (10–1440).
data_description.interval_announcements: Minutes between updates of the announcements (10–1440).
data_description.interval_schedule: Minutes between updates of the schedule (10–1440).
data_description.interval_timetable: Minutes between updates of the timetable (10–1440).
data_description.timeframe: The current month plus this many months (0–6).
data_description.timetable_weeks: The current week plus this many weeks (0–4). One request per week.
data_description.message_count: How many of the last messages are read (1–100).

averages.title: Calculated averages
averages.description: Used only when the school does not show averages in Librus.

data.average_only_counted: Only grades that count to the average

data_description.average_weights: On: weighted mean with the Librus weights. Off: every grade counts once.
data_description.average_only_counted: On: grades marked "Licz do średniej: nie" are skipped.
data_description.average_plus: Added for a plus, for example 4+ = 4.5 with 0.5.
data_description.average_minus: Subtracted for a minus (twice for =), for example 5- = 4.75 with 0.25.

auth_failed.message: Librus rejected the login. Log in again.

unavailable.message: Librus refused the request. The next try comes later.

maintenance.message: Librus is in maintenance. The next try comes later.

invalid_entity.message: {entity_id} is not an entity of a loaded HALibrus entry.

unknown_message.message: Message {message_id} is not on the message list of this student.

cannot_read_message.message: Cannot read the message from Librus: {error}

get_message_content.name: Get message content
get_message_content.description: Reads the full content of a message from Librus. Librus then marks the message as read. The content is read once and kept; later calls do not contact Librus.

entity_id.name: Messages sensor
entity_id.description: The messages sensor of the student.

message_id.name: Message ID
message_id.description: The id of the message from the sensor's message list.
